title: Positive $τ$-bi-Ricci curvature and Mean curvature flow with surgery in hyperbolic space
summary: Let $n\geq3$ and $0\leqτ\leq2$. We prove that every smooth closed connected immersed hypersurface in hyperbolic space whose induced metric has positive $τ$-bi-Ricci curvature admits a mean curvature flow with surgery which has only finitely many surgery times and terminates. In the range compatible with cylindrical necks, the key ingredients are a preserved quantitative spectral pinching condition, which converts the intrinsic hypothesis into uniform two-convexity, and cylindrical and derivative estimates that remain valid across the hyperbolic standard neck replacement.
